blocks.raw: These purpose and category codes can be optionally supplied for any payment, and certain codes are mandatory when making CHAPS payments (e.g. for Property related transactions).
blocks.text: These purpose and category codes can be optionally supplied for any payment, and certain codes are mandatory when making CHAPS payments (e.g. for Property related transactions).

blocks.raw: The codes are derived from the Bank of England/Pay.UK published [UK Purpose Code list](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/-/media/boe/files/payments/rtgs-renewal-programme/iso-20022/uk-recommended-purpose-code-list.pdf) which is a subset of the full international[ External Code Set](https://www.iso20022.org/catalogue-messages/additional-content-messages/external-code-sets) of all acceptable Purpose Codes, which is part of the ISO 20022 repository.
